sources.note: Nothing; 'Knowledge from published sources' field is empty (no published description of Ndrulo listed).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2017. Change Request Number 2017-020: create [dno] Ndrulo / Northern Lendu (submitted by B. Mitterhofer, SIL-UTB; supporters M. Alibu, C. Kutsch Lojenga; adopted 2018-09-14). 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on phonology or stress. Establishes Ndrulo as a separate Lendu-group language (not intelligible with Lendu-Djadhà/Pidhà; closer to Njawló and Ddraló), notes an orthography exists, and cites the only Ndrulo-specific linguistic write-up: Kutsch Lojenga 2013, unpublished.

sources.citation: Kutsch Lojenga, Constance. 1995. Ngiti: A Central-Sudanic language of Zaire [dissertation abstract]. Notes on Linguistics 70: 18-19.
sources.note: Ch. 1 'compare[s] the different regional variants of Lendu with Ngiti'; ch. 4 is the tone system. Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Ndrulo language' (stub, cites Ethnologue 25 only) and 'Lendu language' (inventory from Demolin 1995, Goyvaerts 1988; refs Kutsch Lojenga 1989, Tucker 1940, Trifkovic 1977).
Glottolog 5.3, languoid ndru1234 (Ndrulo): only reference Kutsch Lojenga 1994 pp. 8-9, 428-444 (subclassification).
